name: MFAAlertUsers
label: Alert on users without any form of MFA
inputLabel: Exclude accounts created in the last X days (default: 0, no exclusion)

name: MFAAdmins
label: Alert on admins without any form of MFA (Entra P1 Required)

name: NewMFADevice
label: Alert when users register new MFA devices

name: LicenseAssignmentErrors
label: Alert on license assignment errors

name: SmtpAuthSuccess
label: Alert on SMTP AUTH usage with success, helps to phase out SMTP AUTH (Entra P1 Required)

name: NoCAConfig
label: Alert on tenants without a Conditional Access policy, while having Conditional Access licensing available.

name: AdminPassword
label: Alert on changed admin Passwords

name: InactiveLicensedUsers
label: Alert on licensed users that have not logged in for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last login (default: 90)
Exclude disabled users?
Include users who have never signed in (e.g. sign-in blocked)?

name: InactiveGuestUsers
label: Alert on guest users that have not logged in for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last login (default: 90)
Exclude disabled guest users?

name: InactiveUsers
label: Alert on users that have not logged in for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last login (default: 90)
Exclude disabled users?

name: InactiveSharePointSites
label: Alert on SharePoint sites that have not been active for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last activity (default: 90)
Include never-active sites?

name: InactiveTeamsSites
label: Alert on Teams linked sites that have not been active for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last activity (default: 90)
Include never-active TeamsSite sites?

name: EntraConnectSyncStatus
label: Alert if Entra Connect sync is enabled and has not run in the last X hours

name: QuotaUsed
label: Alert on % mailbox quota used

inputs.inputLabel: Quota percentage threshold (default: 90)
Excluded mailbox UPNs (comma-separated). Supports custom variables like %excludefrommailboxalert% defined under CIPP > Settings > Custom Variables at tenant or AllTenants scope.
Mailbox types to alert on (default: all)

description: Alerts when a mailbox exceeds a percentage of its send/receive quota, using the Microsoft mailbox usage report. The report's storage figure already excludes the Recoverable Items dumpster and the archive, so it reflects what actually counts against the quota. Deleted mailboxes are skipped.

name: ArchiveQuota
label: Alert on % online archive quota used

inputs.inputLabel: Archive quota percentage threshold (default: 90)
Excluded mailbox UPNs (comma-separated). Supports custom variables like %excludefromarchivealert% defined under CIPP > Settings > Custom Variables at tenant or AllTenants scope.

name: StorageQuota
label: Alert on mailbox storage quota (managed clients only, with repeat suppression)

inputs.inputLabel: Percentage of the send/receive quota that counts as at risk (default: 85). Judged on the hard quota, not issueWarningQuota, which is not always rescaled when a mailbox moves to a larger plan.
Days before an unchanged finding is raised again (default: 14). A finding that crosses a band (85/90/95%) is raised immediately regardless.

name: SharePointQuota
label: Alert on % SharePoint quota used

name: OneDriveQuota
label: Alert on % OneDrive quota used

name: OneDriveLongPaths
label: Alert on OneDrive accounts with over-long paths
description: Uses the OneDriveLongPaths Report DB cache (run ExecCIPPDBCache OneDriveLongPaths first). Signals users who may hit OneDrive sync or Office path errors. Alert and cache store owner UPN and counts only — never file or folder names.

name: UnlicensedOneDriveData
label: Alert on leftover unlicensed OneDrive data nearing deletion

inputs.inputLabel: Days until deletion (default: 30)
Include shared mailboxes

description: Fires when a still-existing user has an unlicensed OneDrive within the selected days of unpaid deletion (unlicensed start + 365 days). Skips Entra-deleted owners. Shared mailboxes are excluded unless the toggle is on.

name: DeletedUserOneDriveAccess
label: Alert on deleted users' OneDrive access about to end

inputs.inputLabel: Days before access ends (default: 14)
Only alert when someone holds delegated access

description: Fires for OneDrives of users deleted from Entra ID whose access window ends within the selected days. The window is the tenant's deleted-user OneDrive retention period, capped at 93 days when unlicensed-account billing is off because the site is archived then. Lists who currently holds delegated (site admin) access so they can be warned to copy data out or a licence can be approved.

name: ExpiringLicenses
label: Alert on licenses expiring in X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days until expiration (default: 30)
Minimum days until expiration (default: 0)
Alert only on unassigned licenses

description: Alerts on licenses with a renewal date within the selected number of days. Microsoft does not expose the actual commitment term, so monthly auto-renewing subscriptions also match; set the minimum days to 32 or higher to skip anything renewing sooner than that (such as monthly rollovers).

name: NewAppApproval
label: Alert on app consent requests awaiting admin approval

inputs.inputLabel: Maximum new pending requests to raise per run (default: 10). The excess is recorded as seen and will not re-surface; suppression is logged as a warning.

name: SecDefaultsUpsell
label: Alert on Security Defaults automatic enablement

name: SecDefaultsDisabled
label: Alert when Security Defaults is disabled with no Conditional Access policies

name: DefenderStatus
label: Alert if Defender is not running (Tenant must be on-boarded in Lighthouse)

name: DefenderMalware
label: Alert on Defender Malware found  (Tenant must be on-boarded in Lighthouse)

name: DefenderIncidents
label: Alert on new Defender Incidents found

inputs.inputLabel: Incident severities to include

name: DefenderAlerts
label: Alert on new Defender Alerts found

inputs.inputLabel: Alert severities to include

name: DefenderPendingRemediation
label: Alert on Defender automated remediations waiting for approval
inputLabel: Alert once a remediation has been pending this many hours (default: 24)
description: Raises each Defender alert (email/MDO or device/MDE) whose automated investigation has sat in Action Center 'Pending approval' for longer than the threshold, measured from the alert's creation. Each alert notifies once and resolves when the action is approved or rejected. Pending email actions mean MDO automation is not soft-deleting similar messages on its own; that setting is portal-only. Report only; see ListDefenderPendingRemediation.

name: AsrReadiness
label: Alert on ASR rules ready to move from Audit to Block
description: Monthly ASR readiness check (ListAsrReadiness, 14-day window). Raises rules in Audit with no audit hits over the whole window (Info), rules whose assigned policies conflict (Warning), and one row when Audit rules have no evidence source (advanced hunting device tables missing and no ControlR collector data). No evidence is never treated as no hits. Report only: no policy is changed.

name: Vulnerabilities
label: Alert on software vulnerabilities

inputs.inputLabel: Age threshold in hours (default: 0)
Only alert on items newer than threshold (prevents duplicate alerts)
Minimum CVSS severity
Exploitability levels to include

description: Monitors for software vulnerabilities based on age, CVSS severity, and exploitability level. By default alerts on items older than the threshold; enable 'newer than' mode to only receive alerts for recent vulnerabilities and prevent duplicates. Filter by minimum CVSS score (low=0+, medium=4+, high=7+, critical=9+) and select which exploitability levels to include. Requires Defender for Endpoint/Business.

name: UnusedLicenses
label: Alert on unused licenses

name: OverusedLicenses
label: Alert on overused licenses

name: EntraLicenseUtilization
label: Alert on Entra ID P1/P2 license over-utilization

name: AppSecretExpiry
label: Alert on expiring application secrets
description: Reports app registration client secrets expiring within the next 30 days, and keeps reporting them for 7 days after they expire. Secrets that expired more than 7 days ago are not reported.

name: AppleTerms
label: Alert on new Apple Business Manager terms

name: AppCertificateExpiry
label: Alert on expiring application certificates

name: LongLivedAppCredentials
label: Alert on long-lived app registration secrets or certificates
inputLabel: Maximum allowed credential lifetime in months (1-24)
description: Checks app registrations for client secrets or certificates that are valid longer than the Microsoft UI currently allows. Set a threshold from 1 to 24 months.

name: NewServicePrincipalCredentials
label: Alert on newly added service principal credentials
description: Reports every client secret or certificate added to a service principal (enterprise application) within the look-back window. A credential on a service principal grants its holder the application's permissions in your tenant, so a new one on a multi-tenant app usually means someone other than the vendor added it.

name: SpecificAppIds
label: Alert on presence of specific app ids
description: Alerts when a service principal for any of the listed application ids exists in the tenant. Pick from the list or type any application (client) id. The defaults are the ConnectWise Cloud Management applications named in the ConnectWise breach disclosure.

name: ApnCertExpiry
label: Alert on expiring APN certificates

name: VppTokenExpiry
label: Alert on expiring VPP tokens

name: DepTokenExpiry
label: Alert on expiring DEP tokens

name: IntuneApprovalRequests
label: Alert on Intune changes waiting for multi-admin approval
description: Multi-admin approval holds a protected Intune change until a second administrator approves it, and nothing notifies the requestor. This reports requests still sitting in needsApproval.

name: SoftDeletedMailboxes
label: Alert on soft deleted mailboxes

name: DeviceCompliance
label: Alert on device compliance issues

name: DeviceComplianceGracePeriod
label: Alert on devices in the compliance grace period
description: Devices in the compliance grace period are still trusted, but will be marked noncompliant when the grace period expires. This alerts before that happens so you can fix the device without user impact.

inputs.inputLabel: Only alert when the grace period expires within this many days (default: all devices in grace period)

name: IntunePolicyConflicts
label: Alert on Intune policy or app conflicts/errors

inputs.inputLabel: Alert per issue (off = aggregated)
Include policy status issues
Include app install issues
Alert on conflicts
Alert on errors/failures

description: Monitors Intune policy assignment states and app install statuses for conflicts or errors. Defaults to aggregated alerts with all mechanisms enabled and both conflicts and errors included.

name: BreachAlert
label: Alert on (new) potentially breached passwords. Generates an alert if a password is found to be breached.

name: LicensedUsersWithRoles
label: Alert on licensed users with any administrator roles

name: RoleEscalableGroups
label: Alert on groups or nested groups assigned to a role that could be used for privilege escalation
description: Scans for groups, including nested groups, that are assigned to directory roles and are not role assignable, which allows group owners or group admins to add more users to the group and gain access to a potentially privileged role.

name: HuntressRogueApps
label: Alert on Huntress or CIPP Rogue Apps detected
description: Huntress has provided a repository of known rogue apps that are commonly used in BEC, data exfiltration and other Microsoft 365 attacks. This alert will notify you if any of these apps are detected in the selected tenant(s). For more information, see https://huntresslabs.github.io/rogueapps/. CIPP also maintains its own curated list of rogue apps, so detections may include applications that are not on the Huntress site. See the CIPP documentation for the full list.

name: TERRL
label: Alert when Tenant External Recipient Rate Limit exceeds X %
description: Monitors tenant outbound email volume against Microsoft's TERRL limits. Tenant data is updated every hour.

name: LowDomainScore
label: Alert on domains with low security score
description: Monitors domain security scores from the DomainAnalyser and alerts when scores fall below the specified threshold.

name: MXRecordChanged
label: Alert on MX record changes
description: Monitors MX records for all domains and alerts when changes are detected. This helps identify potential mail routing changes that could indicate security issues or unauthorized modifications.

name: GlobalAdminNoAltEmail
label: Alert on Global Admin accounts without alternate email address
description: Monitors Global Admin accounts and alerts when they don't have an alternate email address set, which is important for password recovery of key accounts.

name: GlobalAdminAllowList
label: Alert on Global Admins outside approved list

inputs.inputLabel: Approved Global Admin UPN prefixes (comma separated)
Alert per non-compliant admin? (off = single aggregated alert)

description: Alerts when Global Administrator accounts are present whose UPN prefix (before @domain) is not in your approved comma-separated allow list. Toggle per-admin alerts to get one alert per user or a single aggregated alert.

name: NewRiskyUsers
label: Alert on new risky users (risk detections on non-P2 tenants)
description: Monitors for new risky users in the tenant. Risky users are defined as users who have performed actions that are considered risky, such as password resets, MFA failures, or suspicious activity. Tenants without Entra ID P2 cannot read risky users, so for them the alert reports new medium/high (or licence-hidden) risk detections from the last 7 days instead, once per detection; auto-containment applies only to P2 tenants. Optionally runs the default BEC containment (set under CIPP Settings > BEC Remediation Defaults; out of the box: reset password, block sign-in, revoke sessions, remove MFA methods, disable inbox rules, block legacy mailbox protocols) automatically for users that newly appear at high risk - this locks the user out without a human in the loop, so enable it only where that is the agreed response.
inputLabel: Automatically contain users that newly appear at high risk (default BEC containment)

name: GroupMembershipChange
label: Alert on group membership changes for monitored groups
inputLabel: Group display names to monitor (comma separated, wildcards supported)
description: Monitors audit logs for membership changes (add/remove) in specified groups. Supports wildcards like 'CA*' or '*Exclusion*'. Particularly useful for tracking changes to groups used in Conditional Access exclusions or other security-critical groups.

name: LowTenantAlignment
label: Alert on low tenant alignment percentage
description: Monitors tenant alignment scores against standards templates and alerts when the alignment percentage falls below the specified threshold. This helps ensure compliance across all managed tenants.

name: RestrictedUsers
label: Alert on users restricted from sending email
description: Monitors for users who have been restricted from sending email due to exceeding outbound spam limits. These users typically indicate a compromised account that needs immediate attention.

name: ReportOnlyCA
label: Alert on tenants with Conditional Access policies in report-only mode

name: QuarantineReleaseRequests
label: Alert on quarantine release requests
description: Monitors for user requests to release quarantined messages and provides a CIPP-native alternative to the external email forwarding method. This helps MSPs maintain secure configurations while getting timely notifications about quarantine activity. Links to the tenant's quarantine page are provided in alerts.

name: StaleEntraDevices
label: Alert on stale Entra devices that have not been active for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last activity (default: 90)
Exclude disabled devices?

name: SecureScore
label: Alert on a low Secure Score

inputs.inputLabel: Threshold type
Threshold Value (absolute/percent: alert when below this value, drop: alert when score decreases by this percentage)

description: Monitors Secure Score and alerts when it falls below the specified threshold (absolute or percent value) or when it drops by a defined percentage compared to the previous score. Helps identify security gaps, regressions, and areas for improvement.

name: TenantAccess
label: Alert on tenant accessibility issues (Graph, Exchange, GDAP roles)
description: Proactively monitors tenant accessibility by testing Graph API connectivity, GDAP role assignments, and Exchange Online access. Alerts when tenants have lost permissions, removed GDAP consent, or are missing required roles. Helps identify tenants that need a permission refresh or offboarding.

name: CheckExtension
label: Alert on new Check phishing extension detections
description: Monitors for new phishing site detections reported by the Check browser extension. Alerts when a user visits a page that the extension flags as a potential credential phishing or AiTM attack. Requires the Check browser extension to be deployed to users.

name: UserReportedPhishing
label: Alert on emails reported by users via Outlook Report Phishing

inputs.inputLabel: Hours to look back (default: 24)

description: Monitors for emails reported by users through Outlook's built-in Report Phishing feature. Alerts when new user-reported email threat submissions are found in Microsoft Defender. Requires ThreatSubmission.ReadWrite.All permission.

name: NewShadowAITool
label: Alert on new Shadow AI tools detected
description: Monitors the Shadow AI detection data (Intune detected apps and Entra consented applications) and alerts when an AI tool is seen in the tenant for the first time. The first run establishes a baseline without alerting. Uses the same cached data as the Shadow AI dashboard, so keep the Detected Apps and Service Principals caches syncing. Optionally ignores tools that have been marked as company sanctioned.

name: PermanentActiveAdminAssigned
label: Alert on new permanent (no end date) admin role assignments

inputs.inputLabel: Approved break-glass accounts: UPN prefixes, UPNs or display names (comma separated)
Privileged roles only? (off = every directory role)

description: Alerts when a user, group or service principal gains a permanent active admin role assignment (no end date) that is not in the approved list. On Entra ID P2 tenants time-bound and PIM-activated assignments are ignored; elsewhere every assignment counts as permanent. The first run only records the current state.

name: PrinterDeployFailure
label: Alert on printers failing to install on devices

inputs.inputLabel: Only alert once the failure has stood for this many hours (default: 24). Intune retries on the next check-in, so a lower value will raise tickets for failures that fix themselves.

name: AppConsentBlocked
label: Alert when users are blocked from an app because admin consent is required

inputs.inputLabel: How many hours of sign-in history to sweep each run (default: 24). The alert only reports applications never seen blocked before, so a short window loses nothing and keeps the query cheap - a 30-day window times out on busy tenants.
Maximum newly blocked applications to raise per run (default: 10). The excess is recorded as seen and will not re-surface; suppression is logged as a warning.

name: NewRole
label: Alert on changes to directory role membership

name: CompromiseSweep
label: Alert on tenant-wide compromise patterns (device-code sign-ins, password spray, distributed brute force, MFA registered on dormant accounts)

inputs.inputLabel: Hours of sign-in history to sweep each run (default: 24). Detections are de-duplicated, so a short window loses nothing; the device-code query times out on long windows.
Password spray: distinct accounts failing from one IP before alerting (default: 5).
Brute force: distinct IPs failing against one account before alerting (default: 3).
Dormant MFA: days without a successful sign-in before an MFA registration is suspicious (default: 30).
Device code allow-list: UPNs or application IDs that legitimately use the device code flow (Teams Rooms, az CLI), comma separated.
Minimum severity to raise: High (only detections with a successful sign-in, device-code sign-ins and dormant-account MFA) or Medium (also blocked spray/brute-force campaigns). Default: Medium.
Maximum new detections to raise per run (default: 10). High severity first; the excess is recorded and logged as a warning.

name: SharingBurst
label: Alert on lateral OneDrive/SharePoint phishing and mass external sharing from one account

inputs.inputLabel: Hours of sharing activity to analyse each run (default: 24, max 168). Findings are de-duplicated, so overlap loses nothing and catches SharePoint audit events that arrive late.
Burst: distinct external recipients one account shares with inside the window before alerting (default: 25).
Burst window in minutes (default: 60).
File spread: distinct external recipients one file reaches over the whole lookback, however spaced out (default: 25).
Send spread: new external mail recipients in 24 h (against the account's previous 7 days) that mark a mail blast after link creation (default: 25).
Allow-list: UPNs that share externally in bulk on purpose (e.g. marketing), comma separated.
Maximum new findings to raise per run (default: 10). High severity first; the rest are recorded and logged.

description: Watches the unified audit log for one account sharing a file with many external recipients within an hour, one file reaching many outsiders over a day, and sharing links followed by a spike in new external mail recipients. Each finding includes any risky or unfamiliar sign-in in the 24 h before and ready parameters for ExecRemoveSharingLink, ExecBulkRemoveSharingLinks and ExecSetOneDriveSharing. Detection only; see ListSharingBurst.

name: BreakGlassActivity
label: Alert on any sign-in by, or change to, a registered break-glass account

inputs.inputLabel: Hours of sign-in and audit history to scan each run (default: 2). Events are de-duplicated, so overlap loses nothing and catches events that reach the logs late.

description: Raises a High alert for every sign-in (success or failure) by a registered break-glass account, every directory change to or by it, and if it is disabled or deleted. Register accounts per tenant with ExecBreakGlassAccounts (Action=Add).

name: BreakGlassPosture
label: Alert on weak break-glass (emergency access) setup
description: Weekly check of the registered break-glass accounts: at least two, cloud-only on *.onmicrosoft.com, permanent Global Administrator, excluded from every enabled Conditional Access policy, non-expiring password, FIDO2 and no person-bound MFA, tested in the last 90 days. Also flags other accounts excluded from many All-users CA policies. Report only.

name: EwsEnabled
label: Alert when EWS is off or unset while apps still use it
description: Microsoft's EWS shutdown flips an unset EwsEnabled to False and EWS stops within about an hour. This alerts when EwsEnabled is False (Error) or unset (Warning) in a tenant where apps hold EWS permissions (backup, email security, iOS Mail). Pin with ListEwsStatus Action=Pin.

name: PhishResistantAdmins
label: Alert on admins without phishing-resistant MFA
description: Weekly check of every holder of a privileged directory role (active and PIM-eligible, group assignments expanded): no passkey, FIDO2 key, Windows Hello for Business, Platform Credential or certificate (Error for Global, Privileged Role and Privileged Authentication Administrator); admin account also licensed or mail-enabled; Global Admin count outside 2-4; passkeys disabled or not self-service; AAGUID restrictions blocking Microsoft Authenticator passkeys. Report only; see ListPhishResistantMfa.

name: SmsMfaReliance
label: Alert on users and admins relying on SMS/voice MFA, and on Authenticator/passkey coverage regressing

inputs.inputLabel: Alert when Authenticator/passkey coverage drops more than this many percentage points below its best (default: 5)

description: Weekly readiness check before disabling SMS/voice MFA (Entra ID P1 needed for the registration report). Raises admins whose only MFA is SMS/voice or who have none, admins defaulting to SMS/voice, one consolidated row for users relying only on SMS/voice and one for licensed users without MFA, and a drop in Authenticator/passkey coverage. The first run records the coverage baseline. Report only; see ListSmsMfaReadiness.

name: StandingPrivilegedAccess
label: Alert on standing Global Admins, privileged guests/apps, inactive admins and GDAP Global Admin

inputs.inputLabel: Days without a successful sign-in before a privileged account counts as inactive (default: 45)
Allow-list: comma-separated appIds or app names of service principals expected to hold roles (* wildcards allowed, e.g. CIPP-SAM, Huntress*). Supports custom variables.

description: Weekly least-privilege check of directory roles: permanent Global Administrators other than registered break-glass accounts (with a suggested smaller role from their Entra audit activity), non-Microsoft service principals and guests holding privileged roles, privileged accounts with no recent sign-in, and GDAP relationships with the customer that include Global Administrator. PIM needs Entra ID P2; without it active roles are treated as standing. Report only; see ListRoleAssignmentReport.

name: NewRoleDefinitions
label: Alert on new directory role definitions (custom roles created)

inputs.inputLabel: Also alert (as Info) on new built-in roles Microsoft adds?

description: Records each tenant's directory role definitions and raises one alert per definition that appears later: a new custom role is a Warning (check what it grants and who holds it). The first run seeds silently. Report only.

name: OAuthHighRiskGrant
label: Alert on high-risk OAuth grants and AI connectors with mail or file access

inputs.inputLabel: Fleet-wide allow-list (every tenant): comma-separated appIds or app names (* wildcards allowed, e.g. Backup Application *). Supports custom variables like %oauthallowlist%.

Tenant-specific allow-list: entries written tenant|appId-or-name, separated by commas (e.g. aspendora.com|e0476654-c1d5-430b-ab80-70cbd947616a). Applies only to that tenant, so an app vetted for one client still alerts everywhere else.

description: Daily live scan of every app's OAuth grants (ListOAuthGrantRisk). Raises apps scored Critical (app-only mailbox, file or directory access with no user signed in) or High (tenant-wide risky delegated consent, unverified publisher), and any AI connector with mail, files or sites scopes, unless allow-listed. Each app notifies once per scope set and resolves when the grant is removed. Includes blast radius and a suggested action (disable the service principal first: it keeps the config).

name: OIBDrift
label: Alert on outdated or retired OpenIntuneBaseline (OIB) policies
description: Weekly check of the tenant's "Win - OIB -" Intune policies against the latest OpenIntuneBaseline Windows release on GitHub. Alerts on policies older than the version in that release (Outdated) and on policies the release deprecated or dropped (Retired). OIB policies the tenant has not deployed are not alerted on, and tenants with no OIB policies produce nothing. Report only.

name: EnrollmentDiscovery
label: Alert on tenants still relying on CNAME-based Intune enrollment

inputs.inputLabel: Include informational findings (legacy CNAME target, missing enterpriseregistration record, CNAME missing while the MDM scope is All)

description: Weekly check of the enterpriseenrollment / enterpriseregistration CNAMEs on every custom verified domain against the Intune MDM user scope: CNAME published while the scope is None or a narrow group, Windows enrollment in use with no CNAME, CNAMEs pointing somewhere unexpected, and GPO / co-management enrolled hybrid devices that depend on the scope. Report only; see ListEnrollmentDiscovery.

name: IntuneStaleCheckIn
label: Alert on Intune devices that have not checked in for X days

inputs.inputLabel: Days since last Intune check-in (default: 14)

description: Raises managed devices whose last Intune sync is older than the threshold. Retired, wiped and delete-pending devices are skipped. Each device notifies once and resolves when it checks in again. Entra sign-in staleness is the separate StaleEntraDevices alert.

name: IntuneEnrollmentFailures
label: Alert on Intune enrollment failures

inputs.inputLabel: Hours of enrollment failure history to scan each run (default: 24). Failures are de-duplicated, so overlap loses nothing.

description: Reads the Intune enrollment troubleshooting log and raises each failure with Intune's reason and suggested remediation. Repeated attempts by the same device for the same reason on the same day are grouped and notify once.

name: IntuneNewDevices
label: Daily digest of newly enrolled Intune devices

inputs.inputLabel: Hours to look back for new enrollments (default: 24)

description: Lists the devices enrolled in Intune in the look-back window (name, user, OS, model, serial, ownership, enrollment type). Each enrollment is announced once.

name: IntuneDuplicateDevices
label: Alert on duplicate Intune device records (same serial number)

inputs.inputLabel: Minimum records sharing a serial number (default: 2)

description: Groups managed devices by serial number (placeholder serials such as "Default string" and retired devices ignored) and recommends keeping the most recently synced record. Report only: nothing is deleted.

name: IntuneNoCompliancePolicy
label: Alert on Intune devices with no compliance policy assigned

inputs.inputLabel: Skip devices enrolled in the last X days (default: 1)
Also raise devices Intune could not evaluate (error / conflict)

description: Uses Intune's built-in "Has a compliance policy assigned" check to raise devices no compliance policy targets, whose compliance therefore comes only from the tenant default. Non-compliant devices are the separate DeviceCompliance alert.

name: IntuneWindowsUpdateFailures
label: Alert on Windows Update failures reported by Intune

inputs.inputLabel: Include expedited quality update profiles (not yet verified live)
Include driver update profiles (not yet verified live)

description: Reads the Intune Windows Update alert reports per feature update profile (and optionally expedited quality and driver profiles) and raises each device/alert pair. Needs Windows diagnostic data enabled for Intune. A run where a report could not be read does not report.

name: DriverUpdatesBlocked
label: Alert when update rings or Settings Catalog policies block Windows drivers

inputs.inputLabel: Also raise unassigned policies that block drivers

description: Raises update rings with Windows drivers set to Block and Settings Catalog policies setting "Exclude WU Drivers In Quality Update" to Exclude. Either stops devices receiving drivers and firmware regardless of the driver update profile. Report only.

name: ExoProvisioning
label: Alert when Exchange Online did not provision correctly (new tenant or SKU)

inputs.inputLabel: Hours a user must be licensed before a missing mailbox is raised (default: 24)

description: Checks that Get-OrganizationConfig answers for a tenant licensed for Exchange, the built-in role groups and core management roles exist, Organization Management holds its roles, verified email domains are accepted domains, and users licensed for a mailbox have one. Tenants without an Exchange licence produce nothing. Report only: run the Exchange role repair from Email > Reports > Exchange Provisioning.

name: MessageCenterDigest
label: Weekly Message Center digest: action required, retirements and security changes

inputs.inputLabel: Mark deadlines within X days as due (default: 30)
Days to look back for new or updated posts (default: 7)
Digest all managed tenants even when not run on the partner tenant

description: Schedule on the partner tenant: reads every tenant's cached Message Center posts, deduplicates them by MC id and raises posts that need action (act-by date, high severity), retirements and security changes once each, listing the tenants affected and the admin center link. Deadline posts notify again when they come due. Informational posts never alert; see Tenant > Reports > Message Center Digest.

name: OooExposure
label: Alert on out-of-office replies that expose colleagues, phone numbers or payment contacts to external senders

inputs.inputLabel: Also raise external (audience All) replies with no contact or payment cues (Medium)

description: Raises mailboxes whose automatic reply goes to every external sender and names a colleague's address, a phone number or a finance cue (invoices, payments, wires, payroll). Each out-of-office period notifies once; the alert carries flags and a masked snippet, never the message. Fix on Email > Reports > Out-of-office Exposure.
